description: Source file implementing AppNotifications functionality, including subscription management, event emission, cleanup, and internal notification handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing app notification handling, subscription, emission, cleanup, and internal notification dispatching.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::SubscriberMap
classes.description: Manages subscribers for different events, including adding, removing, and dispatching notifications.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::ThunderSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Handles Thunder plugin notifications subscription and unsubscription, ensuring proper registration and cleanup.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests for app notifications, managing internal maps and Thunder subscriptions.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits an event with payload to subscribers.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up notifications associated with a specific connection ID and origin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: CleanupNotifications
methods.description: Removes notifications matching a connection ID and origin from the subscriber map.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber for a specific event.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a subscriber for a specific event.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves subscribers for a specific event.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if subscribers exist for a specific event.

methods.name: EventUpdate
methods.description: Dispatches an event update to relevant subscribers, filtered by appId if provided.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches notification to either gateway or launch delegate based on origin.

methods.name: DispatchToGateway
methods.description: Sends notification to the app gateway.

methods.name: DispatchToLaunchDelegate
methods.description: Sends notification to the internal launch delegate.

methods.name: ThunderSubscriptionManager::Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to Thunder notifications for a module and event.

methods.name: ThunderSubscriptionManager::Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from Thunder notifications for a module and event.

methods.name: HandleNotifier
methods.description: Handles registration or unregistration of Thunder notifications via internal notifier interface.

methods.name: RegisterNotification
methods.description: Registers a Thunder notification for a module and event.

methods.name: UnregisterNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a Thunder notification for a module and event.

methods.name: IsNotificationRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a notification is already registered for a module and event.
